scope: Individually read primary-source claims; no blanket source verification

/trade/btc.assessment: Bitcoin.org FAQ selected issuance paragraph states scheduled declining creation and 21-million total. This corroborates the page supply-limit description; it does not validate the displayed price, predict value or certify every Bitcoin claim. Selected claim excerpt read, not the entire long FAQ.

/trade/bnb.assessment: Current BNB Chain BSC validator overview explicitly calls its mechanism Proof of Staked Authority and explains bonded validator selection/slashing. This corroborates the page PoSA label for BSC, not a universal claim about every chain using BNB, historical quotes or returns.

/trade/doge.assessment: Full short official What is Dogecoin page read. It identifies an open-source peer-to-peer cryptocurrency, community and aspiration to wider currency use. It does not quantify current merchant acceptance, fees or confirmation speed. The site wide-acceptance/fast/low-fee wording remains uncorroborated by this source; no false numerical fact or new policy violation is inferred.
